scope: Primary literature for additions within Module 1 and Module 4 conclusions; qualitative interpretation only.

sources.title: Transcriptome-wide off-target RNA editing induced by CRISPR-guided DNA base editors
sources.supports: RNA off-target reduction with retained DNA on-target editing as an engineering outcome.
sources.boundary: Different editor and assay; no ORCA clinical safety threshold.

sources.title: Off-target RNA mutation induced by DNA base editing and its elimination by mutagenesis
sources.supports: Deaminase engineering reduced RNA off-target SNVs while maintaining efficient DNA on-target activity.
sources.boundary: No common toxicity scale or comparable candidate-count denominator.

sources.title: Effective in vivo RNA base editing via engineered cytidine deaminase APOBECs fused with PUF proteins
sources.supports: PUF–APOBEC editing of APOE reporters and endogenous APOE3 in cultured cells.
sources.boundary: APOE site differs from ORCA C388; no Alzheimer therapeutic efficacy calibration.
sources.correction_scope: Figure 7j and associated mouse behavioral source data; not Figure 4 APOE experiments.

sources.title: Effects of Age, Sex, and Ethnicity on the Association Between Apolipoprotein E Genotype and Alzheimer Disease: A Meta-analysis
sources.supports: APOE genotype association motivates disease-relevant study.
sources.boundary: Genotype association is not transcript-editing dose response or a proven upper bound.

decision: Use the qualitative parameter-gap fallback. No epidemiological effect size, delivery assumption or clinical benefit/risk curve is introduced.
